facts.text: WorkSafe New Zealand's August 2017 alert was triggered by "numerous" interactions involving heavy mobile plant, particularly large surface haul trucks.
facts.quote: WorkSafe's August 2017 alert was triggered by "numerous" interactions involving heavy mobile plant, particularly large surface haul trucks.

facts.text: An ordinary-production incident cited in WorkSafe New Zealand's August 2017 alert involved a D10 dozer reversing into the wheel assembly of a fully loaded 777 dump truck at a tip head.
facts.quote: Its examples occurred during ordinary production: a D10 dozer reversed into the wheel assembly of a fully loaded 777 dump truck at a tip head;

facts.text: An ordinary-production incident cited in WorkSafe New Zealand's August 2017 alert involved a reversing truck clipping a dozer on a night shift, damaging the truck's tyre and rim.
facts.quote: on a night shift a reversing truck clipped a dozer, damaging the truck's tyre and rim;

facts.text: An ordinary-production incident cited in WorkSafe New Zealand's August 2017 alert involved an underground loader's bucket catching the tub of a reversing dump truck during stockpile loading, tipping the loader onto its side.
facts.quote: an underground loader's bucket caught the tub of a reversing dump truck during stockpile loading, tipping the loader onto its side [19].
